title: A nonspectrahedral hyperbolicity cone
summary: We construct a homogeneous polynomial of degree 16 in 23 real variables whose hyperbolicity cone has no representation by a finite homogeneous real symmetric linear matrix inequality. This disproves the geometric Generalized Lax conjecture.

review.reason: Constructs a hyperbolicity cone with no finite LMI representation, disproving the geometric Generalized Lax conjecture.
